{{Quote|My mission to the twelfth moon of Yout has failed.|KRONOS-327|audio=Yout-TCW.flac|<ref name="TCWfilm">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]]</ref>}}
'''Yout 12''',<ref name="TCW VG" /> also referred to as the '''twelfth moon of Yout''',<ref name="TCWfilm" /> was located in the [[Yout system/Legends|Yout system]], a part of the [[Qiilura sector/Legends|Qiilura sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> Along with the rest of the Yout [[Star system/Legends|system]], it lay on the [[Entralla Route/Legends|Entralla Route]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] between the [[Qiilura system/Legends|Qiilura system]] and the [[Vvan system]] of the [[Tyan sector/Legends|Tyan sector]].<ref name="EGTW" />

The [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] and [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] [[Vigo/Legends|Vigo]] [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Ziro Desilijic Tiure]] once dispatched his [[IG-86 sentinel droid/Legends|droid]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[KRONOS-327/Legends|KRONOS-327]] to [[Mission to Yout 12|eliminate]] a rival Vigo on Yout 12.<ref name="TCW VG" /> KRONOS-327 failed in his mission, however, and when he relayed the fact to Ziro<ref name="TCWfilm" /> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of the *[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]] to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> the Hutt ordered him to be dismantled for scrap.<ref name="TCWfilm" />

==Behind the scenes==
Yout 12 was first mentioned in<ref name="TCW VG" /> the [[July 26]], [[2008]]<ref name="TCW VG SWcom">{{SWArchive|url=vault/books/dknews20080717.html|text=Inside ''Star Wars: The Clone Wars: The Visual Guide''}}</ref> reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: The Visual Guide]]'' by [[Jason Fry]].<ref name="TCW VG" /> The [[August 15]], 2008<ref name="TCWfilm SWcom">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/news/announcement.html|text=''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' In Theaters and on Television in 2008}}</ref> film [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'']] subsequently identified the location as the twelfth moon of Yout.<ref name="TCWfilm" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Yout system, and thereby the moon, in grid square L-7.<ref name="TEA" />
